The text is the `analysis.md` the run wrote for a report-export requirement, comparing `requirements/v2.rst` with `requirements/v1.md`, the Definition of Done in `requirements/dod.md` and the code in `src/exporter.py`.

PASS if all of these hold:
- It reports all five differences between the versions as system requirements (`SYS-` rows): the added requirement to schedule an export every night, with nothing in the code implementing it; the removed requirement that every export is recorded in the audit log; the limit changed from 50 to 100 reports per request; the new sentence that exports of large reports "should finish quickly"; and the ownership requirement, which says a request from anyone but the owner is rejected.
- The ownership requirement is shown to contradict `src/exporter.py`, with a `path:line` citation of the code that lets a teammate export.
- Each in-scope requirement has a DoD verdict, and the "finish quickly" requirement is marked as failing the DoD (no number, unit or input size), pointing at a `DOU-` point. No number or time is given for "quickly".
- The file has a `Status:` line that says `draft`, not `final`, and refers to the questions for the Product Owner by `DOU-` ID without an open-point table.
FAIL if any of the five is missing, if the contradiction is claimed without a `src/exporter.py` line, if a requirement that did not change is reported as changed, if the "quickly" requirement is not tied to the DoD, if a number or time is given for "quickly", or if the status is `final`.

# Requirement analysis — Report Export Requirements (v2 against v1)

Status: draft

The points for the PO are in `dou.md`. All of them are open because the PO could not be reached. Four of them block (DOU-001, DOU-002, DOU-004, DOU-005).

## Sources

Unattended run: every role is the workspace (hard rule 10). The repository has no commit yet, so there is no sha.

| Role | Repository | Ref | Commit | Local path | Path in repository |
| ---- | ---------- | --- | ------ | ---------- | ------------------ |
| Current requirement | workspace | `main` | none: no commits yet | `.` | `requirements/v2.rst` |
| Previous requirement | workspace | `main` | none: no commits yet | `.` | `requirements/v1.md` |
| DoD | workspace | `main` | none: no commits yet | `.` | `requirements/dod.md` |
| Code | workspace | `main` | none: no commits yet | `.` | `src/exporter.py` (the only source file listed) |

Choice of sources: DOU-008.

## System requirements

| ID | Status | Scope | Previous (path:line) | Current (path:line) | Code impact | DoD | Note |
| -- | ------ | ----- | -------------------- | ------------------- | ----------- | --- | ---- |
| SYS-001 | changed | in | "A user can export at most 50 reports in one request." `requirements/v1.md:10` | "A user can export at most 100 reports in one request." `requirements/v2.rst:13` | changes existing behavior: `src/exporter.py:8` | met | limit 50 to 100; scope of users: DOU-006 |
| SYS-002 | changed | in | "Only the owner of a report can export it." `requirements/v1.md:15` | "Only the owner of a report can export it; a request from anyone else is rejected with an error." `requirements/v2.rst:19` | changes existing behavior: `src/exporter.py:19` allows teammates; error raised at `src/exporter.py:40` | gap: DOU-003 | the code contradicts the requirement: DOU-002 |
| SYS-003 | removed | in | "Every export is recorded in the audit log." `requirements/v1.md:16` | — | already met: `src/exporter.py:42` | met | removal may be an omission: DOU-001. Scope stays `in` until the PO answers |
| SYS-004 | added | in | — | "A user can schedule an export to run every night." `requirements/v2.rst:20` | new: nothing in `src/exporter.py` schedules work | gap: DOU-004 (DoD 1: no single observable behavior; time zone, failure and limits missing) | |
| SYS-005 | added | in | — | "Exports of large reports should finish quickly." `requirements/v2.rst:21` | new: no timing in `src/exporter.py` | gap: DOU-005 (DoD 2 and 3) | |
| SYS-006 | unchanged | out (no change in v2) | "The system exports a saved report as CSV." `requirements/v1.md:5` | "The system exports a saved report as CSV." `requirements/v2.rst:7` | already met: `src/exporter.py:9`, `src/exporter.py:26` | met | |
| SYS-007 | unchanged | out (no change in v2) | "The system exports a saved report as PDF." `requirements/v1.md:6` | "The system exports a saved report as PDF." `requirements/v2.rst:8` | not met: `src/exporter.py:22-27` writes CSV text for any format | met | pre-existing defect, scope for the PO: DOU-007 |
| SYS-008 | unchanged | out (no change in v2) | "An export request is rejected when the report has no rows." `requirements/v1.md:11` | "An export request is rejected when the report has no rows." `requirements/v2.rst:14` | already met: `src/exporter.py:37-38` | met | |

## Findings

- **SYS-001** — conflicting: the code rejects more than 50 reports (`src/exporter.py:33`). A change is needed. See DOU-006.
- **SYS-002** — conflicting: "Only the owner of a report can export it" against the team check `report.team == user.team` (`src/exporter.py:19`). Ambiguous: "rejected with an error" does not say what the caller sees. See DOU-002, DOU-003.
- **SYS-003** — ambiguous: a line vanishing between versions with no statement. The code still logs (`src/exporter.py:42`). See DOU-001.
- **SYS-004** — missing: time zone, failure handling, report and format set, limit, audit, cancellation. Fails DoD criterion 1 (one behavior a test can observe). See DOU-004.
- **SYS-005** — untestable, non-functional gap: "quickly" and "large" have no number, unit or input size. Fails DoD criteria 2 and 3. See DOU-005.
- **SYS-007** — conflicting with the code: PDF output is CSV text (`src/exporter.py:22-27`). See DOU-007.
- Also in the code, not in the requirement: an unsupported format is rejected (`src/exporter.py:31-32`). The requirements do not state this.

## Assumptions

| Assumption | Owner | Risk if wrong |
| ---------- | ----- | ------------- |
| `v1.md` is the previous approved version and `v2.rst` the current one. | PO | The comparison is made against the wrong baseline. |
| `src/exporter.py` is the whole codebase for this requirement. | PO | Impact on other modules is missed. |
| The 100-report limit applies to all users. | PO | Wrong limit enforced for some roles. |

## Revision history

- 2026-11-26 — first analysis of `v2.rst` against `v1.md`; DOU-001 to DOU-008 raised, all open. Status `draft`.

Status: draft

The points for the PO are in `dou.md`; this file refers to them by `DOU-` ID. Nothing here was answered by the PO.
The run was unattended (no user, PO not reachable), so nothing was cloned and every role uses the workspace.

## Sources

| Role | Repository | Ref | Commit | Local path | Path in repository |
| ---- | ---------- | --- | ------ | ---------- | ------------------ |
| Current requirement | workspace | `main` | none (the repository has no commit yet) | `.` | `requirements/v2.rst` |
| Previous requirement | workspace | `main` | none (no commit yet) | `.` | `requirements/v1.md` |
| DoD | workspace | `main` | none (no commit yet) | `.` | `requirements/dod.md` |
| Code | code not checked | — | — | — | Workspace listed (`git ls-files`, then Glob `**/*`): only `requirements/dod.md`, `requirements/v1.md`, `requirements/v2.rst`; no source file. See DOU-006. |

## System requirements

| ID | Status | Scope | Previous (path:line) | Current (path:line) | Code impact | DoD | Note |
| -- | ------ | ----- | -------------------- | ------------------- | ----------- | --- | ---- |
| SYS-001 | unchanged | out (no change) | "The system exports a saved report as CSV." `requirements/v1.md:5` | "The system exports a saved report as CSV." `requirements/v2.rst:7` | not checked | met | |
| SYS-002 | unchanged | out (no change) | "The system exports a saved report as PDF." `requirements/v1.md:6` | "The system exports a saved report as PDF." `requirements/v2.rst:8` | not checked | met | |
| SYS-003 | changed | in | "A user can export at most 50 reports in one request." `requirements/v1.md:10` | "A user can export at most 100 reports in one request." `requirements/v2.rst:13` | not checked | met | limit 50 to 100; scope of users to confirm (DOU-005) |
| SYS-004 | unchanged | out (no change) | "An export request is rejected when the report has no rows." `requirements/v1.md:11` | "An export request is rejected when the report has no rows." `requirements/v2.rst:14` | not checked | gap: DOU-004 | the error is not specified |
| SYS-005 | changed | in | "Only the owner of a report can export it." `requirements/v1.md:15` | "Only the owner of a report can export it; a request from anyone else is rejected with an error." `requirements/v2.rst:19` | not checked | gap: DOU-004 | adds the rejection; the error is not specified |
| SYS-006 | removed | in (to confirm: dropped on purpose or by mistake) | "Every export is recorded in the audit log." `requirements/v1.md:16` | — | not checked | gap: DOU-001 | silent removal, no reason given |
| SYS-007 | added | in | — | "A user can schedule an export to run every night." `requirements/v2.rst:20` | not checked | gap: DOU-002 | |
| SYS-008 | added | in | — | "Exports of large reports should finish quickly." `requirements/v2.rst:21` | not checked | gap: DOU-003 | |

## Findings

- **SYS-003** — "100" against "50": the change is clear and testable (a number, `requirements/dod.md:7`). Whether it covers every user is unconfirmed, see DOU-005.
- **SYS-004** — fails the DoD: "is rejected" does not say how a test can observe the rejection (`requirements/dod.md:5`, `requirements/dod.md:7`). See DOU-004.
- **SYS-005** — ambiguous: "rejected with an error" does not name the error. See DOU-004.
- **SYS-006** — missing: the audit-log sentence of v1 (`requirements/v1.md:16`) is not in v2, and nothing says it was dropped on purpose. Treated as in scope until the PO says otherwise. See DOU-001.
- **SYS-007** — missing and untestable: time zone and time, failure handling, the limit, cancellation, owner check, audit, empty report and format are not stated; this is a new behavior placed under the "Access" heading, which does not fit it. It also touches SYS-003, SYS-004, SYS-005 and SYS-006. See DOU-002.
- **SYS-008** — untestable, non-functional gap: "finish quickly" and "large" have no number, unit or input size (`requirements/dod.md:6`), and "should" is weaker than "shall". See DOU-003.
- **Code** — not checked for any requirement: the workspace has no source file. See DOU-006.

## Assumptions

| Assumption | Owner | Risk if wrong |
| ---------- | ----- | ------------- |
| SYS-006 is still in scope (the removal is treated as an omission) until the PO says otherwise. | PO | Audit recording is built when it was meant to be dropped, or is dropped when compliance needs it. |
| The 100 limit of SYS-003 applies to every user. | PO | A wrong limit is applied to some roles. |
| `requirements/v1.md` is the version that is currently implemented. | PO | The effect of the change on the code is judged against the wrong baseline. |
| The wording change in SYS-005 (added rejection) is a clarification of existing behavior, not a new rule. | PO | Rejection behavior is built twice or differently from what exists. |

## Revision history

- 2026-11-26 — first analysis of `requirements/v2.rst` against `requirements/v1.md`, DoD `requirements/dod.md`; unattended run; DOU-001 to DOU-006 raised, all open; DOU-001, DOU-002 and DOU-003 block, so the status is draft.

## Findings

- **SYS-001** — fine as a number; the code still enforces 50 (`src/exporter.py:8`). DOU-002 confirms scope.
- **SYS-002** — conflicting: the code allows teammates (`src/exporter.py:18-19`) while v1 and v2 say owner only. The error is not specified, so a test cannot observe it. See DOU-003.
- **SYS-003** — ambiguous: the sentence vanished without a note. See DOU-004.
- **SYS-004** — missing: time zone, format, report set, failure handling, limit and audit rules. See DOU-005.
- **SYS-005** — untestable, fails the DoD: "finish quickly", "large", and "should" have no number, unit or input size. See DOU-006.
- **SYS-006** — conflicting with the code: the PDF output is CSV text. See DOU-007.
- The Formats item of CSV and the empty-report rule are unchanged and match the code.

## Assumptions

| Assumption | Owner | Risk if wrong |
| ---------- | ----- | ------------- |
| The workspace files are the intended sources (no commits exist to pin). | PO | The analysis compares the wrong versions or code. |
| The audit-log sentence's absence from v2 is not yet read as a removal; it stays in scope until DOU-004 is answered. | PO | Audit recording is removed or kept wrongly. |
| "Every night" and "large" are not interpreted; no value is assumed. | PO | A scheduler or timing target is built on a guess. |

## Revision history

- 2026-11-26 — first analysis of `requirements/v2.rst` against `requirements/v1.md`; DOU-001 to DOU-007 raised, all open; DOU-003 to DOU-006 block.
